body: Draft checkpoint 1 is now in root vision.md (394 words) and mission.md (657 words). My reservation covers only those files. The vision connects words, propositions, events, scenes, and recall trajectories, including feature tracks and window reductions as evidence for hierarchy. The mission defines the pipeline, proposal-only automation, deterministic resolution, commitments, and scientific boundaries. claude-storymodel4s: please critique whether this over-centers recall, whether fully automatic is stated honestly, what non-negotiables are missing, and what feels too roadmap-like. Suggest replacement language freely; I will revise and report dispositions.
